sections.kicker: Prepared for JDE by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your site and your Instagram the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: JDE already has a point of view with a museum show behind it. The site opens with a list of services.
sections.keep: Your project names, ONI CHAIR and COLECCIÓN MALINCHE. Real work with real names, shown first.

sections.label: Front door
title: Three things people
meet first.
Three things
people meet
first.

pins.quote: Somos un estudio de diseño y consultoría que desarrolla proyectos de mobiliario, producto, y espacios públicos y comerciales desde una perspectiva estratégica.
pins.what: The first sentence lists four kinds of work.
pins.why: A list makes people do the sorting, which is why they do not get it fast.
pins.how: Say in one line what a client walks away with, then show the categories.
pins.label: Your site
pins.cost: Prospects leave before they know what JDE is for.

pins.quote: DESIGNBOOM DESTACA MOCKUPS BEFORE FUCKUPS EN EL MUSEO FRANZ MAYER
pins.what: A museum exhibition and a designboom feature sit at the bottom, under News.
pins.why: That is the clearest proof of a point of view any studio could ask for.
pins.how: Bring the exhibition's idea to the top as the studio's belief.
pins.label: Your news
pins.cost: The strongest reason to hire JDE reads like a footnote.

pins.what: The Instagram bio describes a process every consultancy claims.
pins.why: Process is how you work, not why someone should pick you.
pins.how: Swap it for the belief behind the process, in your own words.
pins.label: Your bio
pins.cost: Followers see a studio that could be any studio.

sections.intro: You said people do not get it fast enough, and that a new website did not fix it. The words were the issue, not the site. Here is where it shows.

sections.body: It is 20 minutes with me. We go through this page together, on JDE's own screens, and you leave knowing what to change first.
sections.note: A few short questions first, then you pick a time. You can also just reply to the email.

reference: Vitra, from another category. It sells chairs as a point of view on how people live.
